test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech. The teacher said, "Let him try on his own."

options.text: The teacher said that he should let him try on his own.
The teacher ordered him to try on his own.
The teacher suggested that he try on his own.
The teacher said that let him try on his own.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The teacher suggested that he try on his own.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" is converted to "suggested" to match the context of advice.
 
 
 
• **Verb:**
 
 
• The imperative sentence "Let him try on his own" is converted into "that he try on his own" in the subjunctive mood.
 
 
 
• **Pronouns:**
 
 
• "Him" remains "him" as it refers to the same person in both direct and indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted into a clause starting with "that."
 
• The original quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The teacher suggested that he try on his own.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The teacher said that he should let him try on his own." 

 
 
• Incorrect because it introduces "should," which changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The teacher ordered him to try on his own." 
 
 
• Incorrect because "ordered" implies a command, not a suggestion.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The teacher said that let him try on his own." 
 
 
• Incorrect grammar; "let" cannot directly follow "said that."
